sources.title: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics collection
facts: DESNZ collection provides local-authority and regional territorial greenhouse-gas estimates using nationally available datasets from 2005 onward.
The collection notes that local statistics alone cannot provide all information needed to monitor local emissions-reduction initiatives.

sources.title: Local authority greenhouse gas emissions: 2025 estimates announcement
facts: DESNZ announces the 2025 local-authority greenhouse-gas estimates for a provisional June 2027 release.
Future-release metadata is not an observed 2025 emissions dataset as of 26 July 2026.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: 2026 provisional figures announcement
facts: DESNZ announces provisional 2026 territorial greenhouse-gas estimates for a provisional March 2027 release.
The announcement describes future statistics based on provisional inland energy consumption and does not contain observed 2026 final emissions.

sources.title: Energy and emissions projections collection
facts: DESNZ publishes energy and emissions projections based on assumptions about future energy use, economic growth, prices, generation costs and population.
Projected greenhouse-gas emissions are modeled future estimates and must remain separate from observed inventory emissions.

sources.title: Energy and emissions projections: 2024 to 2050
facts: DESNZ publishes projections of energy demand, greenhouse-gas emissions and electricity generation from 2024 to 2050.
Projection tables are scenario outputs and are not measured parcel emissions.

sources.title: Carbon budget and growth delivery plan
facts: The DESNZ plan sets out government proposals and policies for meeting statutory carbon budgets.
Policy measures and modeled delivery pathways are not direct measurements of emissions at a site or parcel.

sources.title: Carbon budget and growth delivery plan Section 14 report accessible webpage
facts: The Section 14 report explains carbon budgets as five-year cross-economy caps expressed in MtCO2e and describes proposals and policies for delivery.
A carbon-budget cap or policy contribution is not an observed parcel greenhouse-gas value.

sources.title: Unlocking the benefits of the clean energy economy accessible webpage
facts: The publication describes economic, energy-security, health and environmental benefits associated with the clean-energy transition.
Benefits and policy narratives do not constitute measured greenhouse-gas emissions for a parcel.

sources.title: Carbon border adjustment mechanism policy summary
facts: HMRC summarises the UK CBAM policy framework and notes July 2026 secondary legislation and monitoring/verification provisions.
CBAM embodied-emissions rules apply to imported goods and cannot be treated as land-parcel emissions in England.

sources.title: Factsheet: Carbon border adjustment mechanism
facts: HM Treasury factsheet explains the planned UK CBAM for specified imported goods from 1 January 2027.
A future carbon-pricing mechanism and product-scope emissions methodology are not observed parcel emissions.

sources.title: Environmental permits: when and how you are charged
facts: Environment Agency guidance describes application, variation, transfer, surrender and annual subsistence charges for environmental permits.
Permit charges are administrative monetary values and are not physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: Application for an environmental permit: part C1 varying, adding or changing to a standard rules permit
facts: Environment Agency Part C1 is an application form for varying, adding or changing a standard-rules permit and includes combustion-plant-related application requirements where applicable.
An application or permit variation does not establish an observed greenhouse-gas quantity.

sources.title: Energy consumption in the UK 2025
facts: DESNZ Energy Consumption in the UK tables cover energy use and include a 20 April 2026 revision to domestic end-use estimates for 2017 to 2019.
Energy-consumption statistics are activity evidence and require an explicit supported emissions calculation before use as emissions.

sources.title: Sub-national gas consumption at postcode level in 2025 announcement
facts: DESNZ schedules postcode-level gas 2025 statistics for a provisional December 2026 release.
The future announcement does not provide observed 2025 postcode values as of 26 July 2026.

sources.title: Sub-national gas consumption in Northern Ireland: 2015-2025 announcement
facts: DESNZ schedules Northern Ireland council-level gas consumption for 2015 to 2025 for a provisional December 2026 release.
Future release metadata is not observed emissions or parcel-level gas consumption.

sources.title: NAEI emissions from point sources
facts: NAEI point-source data describe individual industrial and commercial emission sources with known grid references and data from regulatory inventories, ETS records and modeled sources.
A point-source coordinate or facility record is not automatically a canonical land-parcel binding.

sources.title: NAEI gridded emissions data
facts: NAEI provides 1x1 km gridded pollutant emissions downloads with ASCII grids, GeoTIFFs, point-source files and licence information.
A 1x1 km grid value must not be assigned directly to an individual parcel without a separate validated spatial allocation method.

sources.title: NAEI UK Emissions Interactive Map
facts: The NAEI interactive map exposes 2023 emissions layers with grid, point-source and regional query tools.
Interactive map summaries are spatial inventory evidence and are not parcel measurements without verified parcel binding.

sources.title: UK Spatial Emissions Methodology - NAEI 2023
facts: The NAEI 2023 spatial methodology report was re-issued to correct graphs that had shown cumulative source-sector shares instead of the 2023-only breakdown.
The report states accompanying text and gridded data were unaffected, illustrating the need to preserve revision status and methodology version.

sources.title: UK Informative Inventory Report 1990 to 2024
facts: The 2026 UK Informative Inventory Report covers 1990 to 2024 and carries a correction note about the year of road-transport mileage-split data received.
Inventory documentation and corrections constrain methodology but do not create parcel-level measurements.

sources.title: NAEI reports index
facts: The NAEI reports index lists current inventory, devolved administration and spatial methodology reports including 2026 publications.
An index page establishes provenance and version discovery, not a numeric emissions observation.

sources.title: NAEI greenhouse gas emissions reports index
facts: The filtered NAEI report index surfaces greenhouse-gas inventory and spatial methodology reports with report dates and version context.
Catalogue metadata is provenance evidence and must not be treated as an emissions value.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Inventories for England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland: 1990-2023
facts: The 1990-2023 devolved inventory report is an official prior version and explicitly links to the newer 2026 1990-2024 report.
A superseded inventory version must not override a newer applicable version without a documented reason.

sources.title: UK Spatial Emissions Methodology - NAEI 2022
facts: The NAEI 2022 spatial methodology report is an older official methodology version with a newer 2023 report available.
Older spatial methodology must be versioned and must not silently supersede the current methodology.

sources.title: Climate change agreements scheme extension to new sectors and other amendments
facts: HMRC policy note describes changes to the Climate Change Agreements scheme including how the carbon-emissions factor for gas is described and calculated.
A policy calculation factor is not an observed emissions value without supported activity data and an applicable calculation contract.
